title: Cloud Migration Strategy for a Tier-1 Bank
subtitle: Migrating 400+ legacy applications to a hybrid cloud architecture with zero downtime and full regulatory compliance
summary: Data Panther guided a Tier-1 UK bank through the migration of 400+ legacy applications to a compliant hybrid cloud, reducing infrastructure costs by £14M annually while maintaining 100% regulatory compliance.
challenge: A major UK retail bank was running its core banking operations on a fragile estate of on-premises mainframes and mid-tier servers, many of which were over 15 years old. Licensing costs alone exceeded £22M per year, and the bank's core systems required 72-hour planned maintenance windows every quarter — causing significant customer dissatisfaction. The cloud migration ambition had stalled for three years due to regulatory concerns (PRA and FCA requirements around operational resilience, data residency, and third-party risk), a lack of internal cloud expertise, and the sheer complexity of interdependencies across 400+ applications spanning core banking, payments, fraud detection, and customer relationship management.
solution: Data Panther began with a 10-week Discovery and Design phase that produced a detailed application dependency map and a risk-tiered migration wave plan. Applications were classified into four tiers: Retire (12%), Replace with SaaS (18%), Re-platform (41%), and Re-architect (29%). A bespoke regulatory compliance framework was designed in partnership with the bank's legal, compliance, and technology risk teams, addressing PRA SS2/21 operational resilience requirements and FCA data localisation obligations. Data Panther established a hybrid cloud foundation on Microsoft Azure UK South and UK West regions with private connectivity to the bank's remaining on-premises core banking systems via ExpressRoute. The migration itself was executed across 14 waves over 22 months using a Blue-Green deployment methodology, ensuring zero downtime for any customer-facing service during the transition. Each wave included automated compliance validation checks using a custom-built Azure Policy framework before production cutover.
results: All 400+ applications successfully migrated with zero customer-impacting downtime
Annual infrastructure cost reduced from £22M to £8M — a saving of £14M per year
Quarterly 72-hour maintenance windows eliminated; systems now updated on a rolling basis
100% compliance with PRA SS2/21 and FCA data localisation requirements maintained throughout
Application deployment frequency increased from quarterly to on-demand (multiple daily deployments)
Cloud infrastructure unit costs reduced by a further 22% through FinOps optimisation post-migration
